args.name: value
args.docs: The condition subject: a property of the styled component, `{prop}` or `{ctrl.path:prop}`.

args.name: is
args.docs: Applies while the subject equals this operand; a boolean operand tests truthiness (`{false}` negates).

args.name: isNot
args.docs: Applies while the subject differs from this operand; a boolean operand tests truthiness.
